Bug_Explanation: The bug 'InvalidLogMessageFormat' is intended in the code. It occurs when there are missing or extra arguments in the logger messages. Here, in the messages 'forget the arg {}' and 'forget the arg %s', no arguments are provided although placeholders {} and %s are present. In the message 'too many args {}', only one placeholder {} is present but two arguments 'arg1' and 'arg2' are provided.
